title: 辦公室與把事情說明白
subtitle: Office life and explaining things clearly

example.hanzi: 我們的辦公室在捷運站旁邊的十二樓。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen de bàngōngshì zài jiéyùn zhàn pángbiān de shí'èr lóu.
example.gloss: Our office is on the 12th floor of the building next to the MRT station.

example.hanzi: 明天早上九點有一個很重要的會議。
example.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yǒu yí ge hěn zhòngyào de huìyì.
example.gloss: There's a very important meeting at nine tomorrow morning.

vocab.gloss: team; class; grade; (military) squad; work shift

example.hanzi: 我今天要加班,可能九點才能回家。
example.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào jiābān, kěnéng jiǔ diǎn cái néng huí jiā.
example.gloss: I have to work overtime today; I might not get home until nine.

example.hanzi: 她工作很認真,老闆都說她很好。
example.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn rènzhēn, lǎobǎn dōu shuō tā hěn hǎo.
example.gloss: She works very conscientiously; the boss says she's great.

example.hanzi: 這次會議主要是說明新的工作。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zhǔyào shì shuōmíng xīn de gōngzuò.
example.gloss: This meeting is mainly to explain the new work.

grammar.title: 主要 — mainly / the main one
grammar.pattern: 主要(的) + Noun　/　主要是 + Verb Phrase
grammar.explanation: 主要 picks out which thing is the chief or principal one. Put 主要的 before a noun (主要的工作 the main job), or 主要是 before a verb phrase to say what something mainly involves (今天主要是開會 today is mainly about meetings). 主要 is a modifier, not something you can say about a topic by itself.
grammar.contrast: 主要 vs 重要: 主要 = 'main, principal' (which one of several is the chief one); 重要 = 'important' (how much it matters). A meeting can be 很重要 but you cannot say 很主要. If you can put 很 in front, you want 重要.
grammar.common_error: Learners say 這個會議很主要 to mean 'this meeting is very important'. Say 這個會議很重要, and keep 主要 in front of a noun or before 是: 主要的會議 / 主要是說新的工作.

examples.hanzi: 今天開會主要是要說下個月的工作。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì zhǔyào shì yào shuō xià ge yuè de gōngzuò.
examples.gloss: Today's meeting is mainly to talk about next month's work.

examples.hanzi: 他的主要工作是幫老闆寫信。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhǔyào gōngzuò shì bāng lǎobǎn xiě xìn.
examples.gloss: His main job is writing letters for the boss.

grammar.title: 加班 / 上班 / 下班 — separable verb-object words with 班
grammar.pattern: 上班　下班　加班　(+ 時間/地方 before the verb)
grammar.explanation: 班 works with a verb in front of it: 上班 go to work, 下班 get off work, 加班 work overtime. Time and place words go before the whole phrase: 我明天在辦公室加班.
grammar.contrast: 上班 vs 工作: 上班 is about being on shift (going in, being at work); 工作 is the job or the activity. 你在哪裡上班? asks where you report to work; 你做什麼工作? asks what your job is.
grammar.common_error: Learners add an object after these words, e.g. 我上班公司 ✗. Say 我在公司上班 ✓ — the place goes before the verb with 在.

examples.hanzi: 我五點下班,你要不要一起去吃飯?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǔ diǎn xiàbān, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù chī fàn?
examples.gloss: I get off work at five; do you want to go eat together?

examples.hanzi: 她在銀行上班,每天都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yínháng shàngbān, měi tiān dōu hěn máng.
examples.gloss: She works at a bank and is busy every day.

examples.hanzi: 這個週末我還要加班,真的太累了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ hái yào jiābān, zhēn de tài lèi le.
examples.gloss: I have to work overtime this weekend too — I'm really too tired.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 小明,早!老闆在辦公室嗎?
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Míng, zǎo! Lǎobǎn zài bàngōngshì ma?
dialogue.gloss: Morning, Xiao Ming! Is the boss in the office?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 在啊,他九點還有一個會議喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài a, tā jiǔ diǎn hái yǒu yí ge huìyì o.
dialogue.gloss: Yes, he is — and he's got a meeting at nine, too.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 那我下午再去找他。這次會議主要是說什麼?
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiàwǔ zài qù zhǎo tā. Zhè cì huìyì zhǔyào shì shuō shénme?
dialogue.gloss: Then I'll go find him in the afternoon. What's this meeting mainly about?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 主要是說下個月的新工作。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhǔyào shì shuō xià ge yuè de xīn gōngzuò.
dialogue.gloss: It's mainly about next month's new work.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 好,我先去買咖啡,你要不要?
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiān qù mǎi kāfēi, nǐ yào bú yào?
dialogue.gloss: OK. I'm going to buy coffee first — do you want some?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 要!謝謝你。我今天還要加班,真的需要咖啡。
dialogue.pinyin: Yào! Xièxie nǐ. Wǒ jīntiān hái yào jiābān, zhēn de xūyào kāfēi.
dialogue.gloss: Yes! Thanks. I have to work overtime today, so I really need coffee.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de bàngōngshì zài sān lóu.
sentences.gloss: Our office is on the third floor.

sentences.gloss: I have to work overtime today, so I can't go to the night market with you.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zhǔyào shì shuō xīn de gōngzuò.
sentences.gloss: This meeting is mainly about the new work.

passage.title: 我的辦公室
passage.hanzi: 我在台北一家小公司上班,辦公室在捷運站旁邊的七樓。每天早上九點,我們都要先開一個小會議,主要是說今天的工作。我的同事都很認真,中午常常一起去買便當,在辦公室裡邊吃邊講話。今天我要加班,可能八點才能回家。
passage.gloss: I work at a small company in Taipei; our office is on the seventh floor of the building next to the MRT station. Every morning at nine we first have a short meeting, mainly to go over the day's work. My co-workers are all very conscientious. At noon we often go buy lunchboxes together and eat and chat in the office. Today I have to work overtime, so I probably won't get home until eight.

example.hanzi: 老師說得很清楚，我都聽懂了。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de hěn qīngchu, wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le.
example.gloss: The teacher speaks very clearly; I understood it all.

example.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi wǒ míngbai le.

example.hanzi: 這個問題很簡單，別擔心。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí hěn jiǎndān, bié dānxīn.
example.gloss: This question is very simple, don't worry.

vocab.gloss: to express; to show; to say

example.gloss: He nodded to show he agreed.

vocab.gloss: besides; apart from (... also...); in addition to

example.hanzi: 除了咖啡以外，我也喜歡喝茶。
example.pinyin: Chúle kāfēi yǐwài, wǒ yě xǐhuān hē chá.
example.gloss: Besides coffee, I also like drinking tea.

grammar.title: V + 得 + 清楚／簡單：saying how an action is done
grammar.explanation: Put 得 right after the verb to describe how the action comes out. 他說得很清楚 = the way he speaks is clear. If the verb has an object, either move the object to the front (中文說得很清楚) or repeat the verb (說中文說得很清楚). Common adjectives here: 清楚, 簡單, 快, 慢, 好.
grammar.contrast: 說清楚 (verb + result, no 得) is about getting the result: 你要說清楚 = 'say it clearly / make it clear'. 說得很清楚 (with 得) just describes how someone speaks. Use 得 when you are commenting on the manner; drop 得 when you are asking for a result.
grammar.common_error: Learners say 他說得中文很好, putting the object after 得. The object can never follow 得 — say 他中文說得很好 or 他說中文說得很好.

examples.pinyin: Tā Zhōngwén shuō de hěn qīngchu.

examples.hanzi: 你講得太快了，我沒聽清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiǎng de tài kuài le, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu.
examples.gloss: You spoke too fast; I didn't catch it clearly.

examples.hanzi: 老師說得很簡單，大家都明白了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de hěn jiǎndān, dàjiā dōu míngbai le.
examples.gloss: The teacher explained it very simply, so everyone understood.

grammar.title: 除了……以外，還／也……
grammar.pattern: 除了 + A （以外），還／也 + B
grammar.explanation: 除了 A 以外，還 B means 'besides A, also B' — A is included and B is added. 以外 can be left out in speech: 除了捷運，你也可以坐公車。
grammar.contrast: With 都 instead of 還／也, the meaning flips to exclusion: 除了我以外，大家都到了 = everyone except me. 還／也 adds; 都 excludes.
grammar.common_error: Learners forget the second half. 除了 almost always needs 還, 也, or 都 later in the sentence.

examples.hanzi: 除了中文以外，他還會說一點台語。
examples.pinyin: Chúle Zhōngwén yǐwài, tā hái huì shuō yìdiǎn Táiyǔ.
examples.gloss: Besides Chinese, he can also speak a little Taiwanese.

examples.hanzi: 除了週末，我每天都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Chúle zhōumò, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng.
examples.gloss: Apart from the weekend, I'm busy every day.

examples.hanzi: 除了悠遊卡以外，我還帶了一點錢。
examples.pinyin: Chúle yōuyóukǎ yǐwài, wǒ hái dài le yìdiǎn qián.
examples.gloss: Besides my EasyCard, I also brought a little cash.

dialogue.speaker: 旅客
dialogue.hanzi: 請問，這裡怎麼去台北車站？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ zěnme qù Táiběi Chēzhàn?
dialogue.gloss: Excuse me, how do I get to Taipei Main Station from here?

dialogue.speaker: 路人
dialogue.hanzi: 很簡單，你搭捷運，兩站就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, nǐ dā jiéyùn, liǎng zhàn jiù dào le.
dialogue.gloss: It's easy — take the MRT and you're there in two stops.

dialogue.speaker: 旅客
dialogue.hanzi: 你說得太快了，我沒聽清楚，可以慢一點嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tài kuài le, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, kěyǐ màn yìdiǎn ma?
dialogue.gloss: You spoke too fast, I didn't catch it. Could you go a bit slower?

dialogue.speaker: 路人
dialogue.hanzi: 好。除了捷運以外，你也可以坐公車喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo. Chúle jiéyùn yǐwài, nǐ yě kěyǐ zuò gōngchē ō.
dialogue.gloss: Sure. Besides the MRT, you can also take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: 路人
dialogue.hanzi: 你笑了，表示你真的聽懂了吧！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xiào le, biǎoshì nǐ zhēn de tīng dǒng le ba!
dialogue.gloss: You're smiling — that means you really understood!

sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de hěn qīngchu.
Zhè ge cài zuò qǐlái hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.gloss: This dish is very simple to make.

sentences.pinyin: Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu dào le.
sentences.gloss: Apart from me, everyone has arrived.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng shuō, biǎoshì tā bù xiǎng qù.
sentences.gloss: Saying it that way means he doesn't want to go.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi wǒ míngbai le.

passage.title: 我的中文老師
passage.hanzi: 我的中文老師說話很慢，也很清楚，所以我都聽得懂。她說學中文其實沒那麼難，除了上課以外，還要多聽多說。上個週末我在捷運上跟一個台灣人講話，他笑著表示我說得很好。那時候我心裡很高興，也明白了一件簡單的事：只要每天多說，就會越來越好。
passage.gloss: My Chinese teacher speaks slowly and very clearly, so I can understand everything. She says learning Chinese isn't really that hard: besides going to class, you have to listen and speak a lot. Last weekend I talked with a Taiwanese person on the MRT, and he smiled and said I spoke well. At that moment I was very happy, and I understood one simple thing: as long as you speak a little more every day, you'll keep getting better.
